scenes.line2: How do you keep data fresh?
scenes.say: Why do caching strategies matter? How do you keep data fresh and fast?

rows.b: App loads data into cache on demand

scenes.say: Cache-aside loads data when needed. Write-through updates cache and database together. Time-to-live controls expiry. Invalidation removes stale cache data.
Cache-aside is on-demand and app-managed, great for read-heavy loads. Write-through syncs cache and database, prioritizing consistency.

scenes.label: TTL
scenes.sub: Set cache expiry, like 10 minutes, to balance load and freshness.
scenes.say: Time-to-live sets cache expiry, like ten minutes, to balance freshness and load.

scenes.question: Is write-through always faster?
scenes.right: No, write-through can increase write latency by syncing cache and database.
scenes.say: Is write-through always faster? No, write-through can increase write latency because it syncs cache and database.
